description: The bar chart compares the self-report accuracy of GPT-40 and GPT-4o-mini models before and after introspection training. The vertical axis represents the self-report accuracy, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick labels at intervals of 0.25. The horizontal axis lists two models: GPT-40 and GPT-4o-mini. For each model, there are three bars representing the accuracy before introspection training (gray), after introspection training (blue), and the control group (purple). The control group bars are significantly shorter than the other two, indicating lower accuracy. The blue bars for both models are taller than the gray bars, showing an increase in accuracy after introspection training. The tallest bar is for GPT-4o-mini after training, suggesting it has the highest accuracy among the groups. The chart does not include any additional annotations or visual emphasis on the bars.
